title: C++ Data Structures
description: Classic data structures built from structs and pointers: the LIFO stack, the FIFO queue and the singly linked list, their core operations and complexity, plus the std::stack, std::queue and std::list containers.

descriptionI18n.zh-Hant: 以結構體與指標實作的經典資料結構：後進先出的堆疊、先進先出的佇列、單向鏈結串列，以及它們的核心操作、時間複雜度，還有 std::stack、std::queue 與 std::list 容器。

questions.prompt: Which structure removes the most recently added element first?

prompt.zh-Hant: 哪一種結構會優先移除最後加入的元素？

explanation.zh-Hant: stack 是後進先出（LIFO）：最後推入的元素最先彈出；queue 是先進先出，priority_queue 則依優先權取出。

questions.explanation: A stack is last-in, first-out: the element pushed most recently is popped first. A queue is first-in, first-out, and a priority_queue removes by priority instead of insertion order.

questions.prompt: In a queue, where are new elements added and where are elements removed?

prompt.zh-Hant: 在佇列中，新元素從何處加入，元素又從何處移除？

a.zh-Hant: 從尾端加入，從前端移除

c.zh-Hant: 從前端加入，從尾端移除

explanation.zh-Hant: 佇列是 FIFO：enqueue（push）在尾端加入，dequeue（pop）從前端移除，因此最早進入的元素最先離開。

options.text: Added at the back and removed from the front.
Added at the front and removed from the back.

questions.explanation: A queue is FIFO: enqueue (push) adds at the back and dequeue (pop) removes from the front, so the element that has waited longest leaves first.

questions.prompt: For a singly linked list with a pointer to the head node, what is the time complexity of inserting a new node at the head?

prompt.zh-Hant: 對一個保有頭節點指標的單向鏈結串列，在頭部插入新節點的時間複雜度是多少？

explanation.zh-Hant: 在頭部插入只需把新節點的 next 指向舊的 head，再更新 head，不必走訪任何節點，所以是 O(1)。

questions.explanation: Inserting at the head only redirects the new node's next pointer to the old head and updates the head pointer, so no traversal is needed: O(1).

questions.prompt: Which standard container adaptor provides first-in, first-out behaviour?

prompt.zh-Hant: 哪一個標準容器配接器提供先進先出的行為？

explanation.zh-Hant: std::queue 是配接器，預設以 std::deque 實作，提供 push、pop、front、back 的 FIFO 介面；std::vector 與 std::list 是序列容器。

questions.explanation: std::queue is a container adaptor, implemented on std::deque by default, exposing push, pop, front and back with FIFO behaviour. std::vector and std::list are sequence containers, not adaptors.

questions.prompt: Which operations on a std::stack are O(1)? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列哪些 std::stack 的操作是 O(1)？可多選。

explanation.zh-Hant: stack 只允許在頂端操作，push、pop、top 都只碰頂端元素，皆為 O(1)；它也不提供隨機存取。

options.text: random access to an element in the middle

questions.explanation: A stack exposes only the top, so push, pop and top all run in O(1). It deliberately offers no random access to elements below the top.

questions.prompt: Which statements about a singly linked list built from nodes are true? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列關於以節點建立的單向鏈結串列的敘述，哪些是正確的？可多選。

a.zh-Hant: 每個節點儲存一個值和一個指向下一節點的指標

b.zh-Hant: 若已持有某節點的指標，在它之後插入新節點是 O(1)

c.zh-Hant: 讀取第 k 個元素只需 O(1) 時間

d.zh-Hant: 所有節點都存放在同一塊連續記憶體中

explanation.zh-Hant: 節點通常以 struct 定義，包含 value 與 next；插入靠調整指標，但讀取第 k 個元素必須從頭走訪，是 O(n)，且節點是分散配置的。

options.text: Each node stores a value and a pointer to the next node.
Given a pointer to a node, inserting a new node after it is O(1).
Reading the k-th element takes O(1) time.
All nodes are stored in one contiguous block of memory.

questions.explanation: A node is typically a struct holding a value and a next pointer, which makes insertion after a known node O(1). There is no random access, so reaching the k-th element needs a walk from the head, and the nodes are allocated separately rather than contiguously.

questions.prompt: A queue serves the element that has been waiting the longest first.

prompt.zh-Hant: 佇列會先服務等待最久的元素。

explanation.zh-Hant: 佇列是先進先出，最早加入的元素位於前端，因此最先被移除。

questions.explanation: A queue is first-in, first-out: the element that entered first sits at the front and is removed first.

questions.prompt: std::stack and std::queue are container adaptors that wrap another container, std::deque by default.

prompt.zh-Hant: std::stack 與 std::queue 是容器配接器，包裝另一個容器，預設為 std::deque。

explanation.zh-Hant: 兩者都提供受限介面，底層預設用 std::deque；也可指定 std::vector 或 std::list 作為底層容器（須符合各自需求）。

questions.explanation: Both are adaptors with a restricted interface over an underlying container, std::deque by default. You can name a different container, such as std::vector for a stack, as long as it supports the required operations.

questions.prompt: The operation that adds an element to a stack is usually called ____.

prompt.zh-Hant: 把元素加入堆疊的操作通常稱為 ____。

explanation.zh-Hant: 加入稱為 push（推入），移除稱為 pop（彈出）；std::stack 的成員函式正是 push 與 pop。

questions.explanation: Adding is called push and removing is called pop; std::stack names its member functions exactly push and pop.

questions.prompt: In two or three sentences, explain when you would choose std::list over std::vector, and what you give up by doing so.

prompt.zh-Hant: 用兩至三句說明：何時會選擇 std::list 而不是 std::vector，以及這樣做要放棄甚麼。

model.zh-Hant: 當需要在容器中間頻繁插入或刪除，而且已持有該位置的迭代器時，std::list 只需調整指標，操作為 O(1)，迭代器也不會因其他插入而失效。代價是失去隨機存取（走訪第 k 個元素為 O(n)），節點分散配置使快取效率較差，且每個節點都有額外的指標與配置成本。

explanation.zh-Hant: 選擇取決於操作模式：中間插入刪除多選 list，需要隨機存取與快取友善的連續記憶體則選 vector。

answer.model: Choose std::list when you insert and erase in the middle of the container often and already hold an iterator to that position: the list relinks pointers in O(1) and its iterators stay valid across other insertions. The price is losing random access, so reaching the k-th element is O(n), and the separately allocated nodes hurt cache locality and add per-node pointer and allocation overhead.

questions.explanation: The choice follows the access pattern: frequent middle insertion and erasure favour std::list, while random access and cache-friendly contiguous storage favour std::vector.
